notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Rebindable Controls
notes.content:
Hey all!

Patch 1.0.2 is available now!


 Rebindable controls for both keyboard + xbox game pad
 in-game button prompts update based on customized controls
 D-Pad for movement on game pads is available by default


Thanks for everyone's patience on this; this is one of those features that (on the surface) seems really simple and straightforward but was actually quite a pain to implement in practice. Regardless, I'm really happy this is finally in the game, it makes the game much more accessible.

-lum

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
March 6th, 2021 Patch 1.0.1


Fixed bug where re-completing a puzzle caused an invisible item to appear, which you could pick up
Fixed bug where you could pause the game while in the storage box
Fixed some errors that could occur in areas where the 'killer' is not meant to appear
Fixed bug where no sound effects were played in a specific area
*Potentially* fixed "game corruption bug", which caused your inventory to be full of unusable scissors, a bizarre screen effect to appear, and more. 


A note on the "game corruption bug". I was not able to replicate this through normal gameplay, however there was a line of code which had the potential to cause this bug. I've added additional 'safety checks' to prevent this issue from happening, however it's possible it may still occur.

If you do run into the 'game corruption bug', you can restore you game by closing the game and reopening it. Please let me know if this issue continues to happen!

Thanks!
